items.rss_summary:
A working holiday scheme agreed between Hong Kong and Chile during the Apec summit in Shenzhen last week is expected to launch in the first half of 2027, offering 100 places a year on each side, the labour minister has said.
Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun Yuk-han said on Sunday that the programme, the city’s 15th such arrangement and its first with a South American country, would give young Hongkongers another option.
He added that talks on working holiday agreements were under way..
